title: Best Laid Plans
summary: Recover the temple plans and confront the opposing faction's contact.
overview: Recover the temple plans and confront the opposing faction's contact.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Prepare for the contact and both assistants before completing the handoff.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Looting the plans causes the contact for the current faction route to appear.
The handoff produces an opposing contact with two assistants.
The opposing contact loses protection and becomes attackable.

notes: Approval E316. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
